# Lumen

Skills that teach agents to work with Lumen. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [ory/lumen](https://github.com/ory/lumen), at commit `f60f9ec`.

Precise local semantic code search via MCP.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Lumen**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Lumen**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install lumen@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `doctor`, `reindex`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/ory/lumen
